status: PRE-CALIBRATION conditional protocol; not a claim that the original geometric gates passed
target: Finite-height circular-patch deformation under one unchanged material law, calibrated only on small-region maximum shortening
retrospective: Published shapes/labels and source outcomes were seen during audit; computational withholding only

discretization.scope: Declared discrete mechanical experiment; mesh sensitivity remains an unpassed continuum-accuracy requirement

geometry.reference: Flat stress-free idealization, not an observed embryo geometry
geometry.boundary: Axis regularity and clamped outer meridional boundary; apical/basal free except elastic membrane forces

material_scenarios.scope: Declared conditional scenarios, NOT independently measured bounds, a full identified set or an uncertainty distribution. Every scenario is retained.

activation: Prescribed quadratic material-fibre contraction potential, strength=(one common fitted gain)*published recruitment; parameter work for this chosen potential gauge is externally prescribed, with NO calibrated optical/chemical energy expenditure

calibration.endpoint: maximum vertical material-column shortening within activation patch, used as an explicit peak-quasiequilibrium proxy
calibration.selection: Calibration-only squared-error minimization using tabulated nonlinear responses; selected candidate rechecked against direct solves. Report interpolation error and finite-grid/boundary limitations.
calibration.failure: Failed or nonphysical solves are retained and cannot be silently treated as predictions or removed to choose a favorable branch. Boundary gain estimates are reported; any extension is a retained calibration-only protocol revision.

prediction.inputs: Larger diameter and measured optical recruitment only; response fields removed before model execution
prediction.branch_rule: Report every retained material scenario; no selection using larger-region outcomes
prediction.slice_operator: scripts/spatial_observer.py; missing acquisition slice height yields set-valued possible labels, never a forced positive prediction
prediction.time_limit: Static equilibria are not transient peak/recovery predictions. Any comparison to experimental transient labels is conditional on an unverified peak-quasiequilibrium approximation.

verification.volume: Report local J range and global volume change; penalty compressibility is not exact incompressibility
verification.energy: Verify passive positivity, supplied activation work and energy reduction during relaxation
verification.numerics: Mesh/quadrature differences are empirical sensitivity, NOT rigorous continuum-error certificates

original_scope_gaps: Unknown specimen geometry, material scale/prestress/contact and source slice/time acquisition prevent unconditional specimen-resolved validation.
The finite scenario grid does not characterize the complete physically admissible calibration identified set.
No ellipse/orientation prediction follows from an axisymmetric model.
The five-gate objective is not complete merely because this conditional experiment executes.
